newsitem.title: USA: Stocks set third record close in a row.
newsitem.headline: Stocks set third record close in a row.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks shook off an early bout of profit-taking Friday to set a third straight record, extending the market's post-election rally.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average rose 13.78 points to 6,219.83, its third record close in a row. The Standard & Poor's composite index of 500 stocks also set a record, gaining 3.17 points to 730.82.
In the broader market, advancing issues led declines by a small margin on active volume of 405 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
